symptom: Projects written by mxcli carry IsDefaultType on ImportMappings$ValueMappingElement (x49) and ExportMappings$ValueMappingElement (x1), a key Mendix declares only on the object mapping element, so mx diff / merge throws while mx check and the build stay green
cause: #882 removed the key from the standalone import/export-mapping writer (mapping_write.go), but the consumed-REST inline mapping writer (restInlineMappingElementToGen, used for both Body: MAPPING and Response: MAPPING) builds its own value elements and still wrote addBool(v, "IsDefaultType", false). The legacy modelsdk/mpr serialize_mappings.go / serialize_web_services.go had the same line but had no caller anywhere, tests included
insight: A per-type property fix is only done when every builder of that $Type is fixed: grep the storage name ("$ValueMappingElement") and the key across the repo, not the writer named in the report. Mapping elements have three builders here (import mapping, export mapping, REST inline), and the inline one is the high-count source in real projects because every REST operation with a mapped body or response gets one. Assert on the encoded BSON (codec.Encoder), walking nested children and counting visited value elements, so an empty tree cannot pass. Delete dead legacy twins rather than patch them, after grepping their exported entry points for callers
